NodeSchema: Item{text; type in [idea|question|assumption|hypothesis|lead|known Claim|evidence need|possible cause]}
RequiredReview: Optional per item; promotion requires review
CompletionCriteria: At least one typed item; proposals not upgraded
ProhibitedConclusions: Any item treated as fact without promotion

CompletionCriteria: Each slot answered-with-evidence or marked unknown
ProhibitedConclusions: Fabricated answer for an unknown slot

CompletionCriteria: Every hypothesis has an evidence profile
ProhibitedConclusions: App selects the true hypothesis autonomously

CompletionCriteria: Each open need has a request

NodeSchema: Why{text; status; supporting; opposing; assumptions; review}
AllowedEvidenceStates: source-stated; rule-supported; inferred; disputed; unsupported; human-confirmed; human-rejected
CompletionCriteria: Stops when evidence no longer supports a deeper level
ProhibitedConclusions: Forcing five levels without supporting evidence

CompletionCriteria: At least one branch populated with candidate causes
ProhibitedConclusions: Declaring any bone the confirmed root cause

CompletionCriteria: A recorded human decision selects/records the root cause
ProhibitedConclusions: App confirms the root cause itself

NodeSchema: Action{action; type corrective|preventive; linked cause; owner; priority; due; status; implementation evidence; effectiveness measure; effectiveness date; reviewer; closure decision}
CompletionCriteria: Each action links a cause; closure is a human decision
ProhibitedConclusions: Auto-closing a CAPA or declaring it effective

CompletionCriteria: Each closed action has an evidence-backed check
Every in-scope contradiction shown with both sides
ProhibitedConclusions: Averaging or picking a winner between accounts

CompletionCriteria: Every in-scope gap categorized (searched scope stated)
ProhibitedConclusions: Implying wrongdoing from absence of evidence

NodeSchema: Row{event; lineage date; precision; status; evidence}
CompletionCriteria: Undated rows labelled; each material row cited
Each rated item cites its basis
ProhibitedConclusions: Presenting a rating as a certain outcome

CompletionCriteria: Scores cite basis; final choice is a human decision
ProhibitedConclusions: App making the final decision autonomously
